boundary.description: From the crossing of Leeds Liverpool Canal and Aqueduct Road, through Bolton Road to and S along River Darwen, then W along Sandy Lane to M65 Motorway, to and N along Stockclough Lane, and along a track via Fowler Fold, but excluding Lower Whitehalgh Farm to the junction of Horden Rake and Brokenstone Road, excluding Horden Farm and by a straight line to between 531 and 533 Livesey Branch Road, then by a beeline to and along Beechwood Drive and Leeds and Liverpool Canal to the point opposite Amberwood Drive.
